description: This file defines a Drupal plugin class 'ModerationOptOutPublish' that extends the 'PublishAction' class to provide an alternative publish action which skips moderation checks for entities. It includes dependency injection of services like moderation information, bundle info, and messenger, and overrides the 'access' method to restrict publishing of moderated entities with a warning message.

classes.name: ModerationOptOutPublish
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides an alternative publish action which skips moderation for entities, extending the core PublishAction and implementing container factory for dependency injection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the plugin with services for moderation info, bundle info, and messenger.

methods.name: access
methods.description: Overrides the access method to prevent publishing of moderated entities, displaying a warning message and returning forbidden access if the entity is under moderation.
